text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, during a mock race
at Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And now, the race is reaching its climax!
Meisho Doto surges forward on the final turn! And now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaaaaaaaa!!
I can't tuuuuurrrrnnn!?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she's running off course! Clearly way too much speed!
Why is she always so fragile in the clutch!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I messed up again~. I'm always
so clumsy, so slow, and so useless~...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Is there no salvation...? Is there really no hope for me anywhere~?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(I want to gain confidence somehow.
I want to win lots of races and change this useless self of mine...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Before me, unable to let go of such a dream,
salvation appeared one day.)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! So your name is Meisho Doto?
And I am—TM Opera O!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A natural-born star and supreme ruler!
Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (TM Opera O-san... An Umamusume of my generation who is always full of confidence. Someone I truly look up to...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (And—one more person.)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hu...... st-strength...?
S-S-So sorry, my ears must be playing tricks on me, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Not knowing when to give up is your greatest strength."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Refusing to give up is your strong point."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wasn't just hearing things?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer, who called my flaws my strengths.
The one who pushes my dreams forward...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (Because the two of them are here for me, I...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, Doto-san!
That was quite a run, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: With this, I'm sure to grasp happiness in the Twinkle Series. Don't you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto's challenge in the
Twinkle Series was finally about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her close friend, the fortune-telling-loving Umamusume
Matikanefukukitaru, also came by to celebrate her new beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though Matikanefukukitaru is her senior,
as fellow Umamusume seeking good fortune and salvation,
they seem to hit it off surprisingly well.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Fukukitaru-san~.
Someday, I'll definitely become a sparkling, confident Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "I can become one... right? It's okay to dream, isn't it, Trainer...? If I don't give up and keep trying my best..."
choice_data_list: Yeah, your efforts will definitely bear fruit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto definitely has a fair amount of talent.
The problem is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, so Trainer...
About where we go from here...
choice_data_list: What should we do about your final goal?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeeh, our ultimate goal~?
That's so sudden..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A-A-Anyway, first of all, I want to run
in as many races as possible and build up my strength.
And then, and then~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho, and then?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Someday, I want to be of use to you, Opera O-saaan!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*Faceplants!!* Isn't that dream a bit too
modest? Just lending a helping hand?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The issue is――this bottomless faint-heartedness. She's a fairly
resilient kid, but without her spirits lifting,
she'll never achieve greatness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dreams and confidence, huh. Are ya really plannin' on carryin' that kinda stuff and chargin' ahead, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, don't say I didn't warn ya.
When you slam headfirst into the wall of reality and get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Shakur-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Air Shakur.
She shares a room with Meisho Doto and is one year younger.
She's supposedly skilled at data analysis, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... if not with dreams or confidence,
then what should I run with...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? Hey, you, fortune teller over there. Let me see that slip of paper you were holding just now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You've got the data recorded, right? Hand it over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur looks over the data handed to her.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Ain't enough.
No matter how ya look at it, it ain't enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"With such flimsy numbers, you won't reach anything.
Later."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauuuu, Trainer,
Shakur-san says it's not enough.
It's all over, hauuu~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't take Air Shakur's words at face value,
but... it's true I'm lacking in many areas to reach the top. Still...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Please don't abandon me, Trainerrr!
I'll do my best, I really will~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let us believe that salvation awaits.
As long as we keep this undaunted spirit alive.
